This is a callback API. Appcharge calls this endpoint on your server when specific events occur. Notifies your system to personalize the web store for a player.

Appcharge calls this endpoint when:
  • A player logs in to your web store.
  • A player completes a purchase.
  • Every 5 minutes after the player’s last sync.
